item.title: Veeda Raises $90M to Build Robot Training World Models
item.description: The former Nvidia researchers aim to create simulated worlds where robots can learn safely through large-scale trial and error.

item.title: ⚡ 2 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 20
item.description: · MT Lab proposed an ICML 2026 method for seamlessly editing multilingual text embedded in complex images.（InfoQ 中文） · Microsoft is recruiting a chief legal engineer combining AI and legal expertise, offering annual compensation approaching $280,000.（IT之家）

item.title: ⚡ 12 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 20
item.description: · Anthropic reportedly uses an unreleased system called Model 2 internally while withholding it from customers.（The Decoder） · A KDC architecture article argues that retaining interaction history alone does not give long-running agents functional memory.（InfoQ 中文） · A reported Kimi K3 research system coordinates 18 agents, with its harness helping performance approach Claude Opus 5.（量子位） · Binance opened trading access to AI agents, while placing much of the responsibility for agent controls on users.（TechCrunch） · China’s AI sector is developing circular financing arrangements linking chip suppliers, model companies and infrastructure spending.（The Decoder） · Terence Tao warned that unreliable AI-generated mathematical results could create the field’s largest foundational crisis since Gödel.（The Decoder） · Alibaba demonstrated Wan 3.0 turning uploaded documents, images or websites into generated creative outputs.（X / Alibaba Wan） · OpenAI highlighted companies embedding its open-source Codex harness into internal applications, operations dashboards and customer-facing builders.（X / OpenAI Developers） · Vercel’s v0 temporarily cut prices for GPT-5.6 Sol and Fast mode by 50% through September 18.（X / v0） · Smolmachines introduced smolvm, a WebAssembly-based sandbox for executing untrusted Python and JavaScript generated by AI systems.（Simon Willison） · Pika showcased Seedance 2.5 extrapolating editing style, music and camera language from several visual references at 1080p resolution.（X / Pika） · Google Cloud launched its All Things Agentic hackathon for developers building Gemini-powered agents that automate complex work.（X / Google Cloud Tech）
